explanation: The US Constitution and the Judiciary Act of 1789 set up America's top court. Britain's opened only in 2009, taking over from judges who sat in the House of Lords.
learnMore: Supreme Court of the United Kingdom

claims.text: The US Supreme Court was established under the US Constitution and organized by the Judiciary Act of 1789.
The Supreme Court of the United Kingdom began work on 1 October 2009.
The UK Supreme Court took over the role of highest court of appeal from the Appellate Committee of the House of Lords.
